title: Dependency-bump update outcome
description: Declaration authored by the update agent after the bump/install/resolve stage.

outcome.description: RESOLVED = tree installs clean; NO_CHANGES = nothing to bump; BLOCKED = could not safely resolve.

conflicts.description: Each ERESOLVE conflict and the chosen remedy.

overridesAdded.description: Scoped root overrides added, if any.

holdbacks.description: Dependencies held back via targeted rollback.

filesChanged.description: Tracked files changed; empty when the tree was restored.

stopReason.description: Non-null when BLOCKED: what could not be resolved and what a follow-up needs.
